finding: Historical work-admission recovery previously had three route mismatches: pre-push correctly blocked a critical emergency commit without forward attestation, but `git recover-push-fail` replaced the attestation blocker with generic retry guidance; `git attest` was reported absent from help; and the generated fixed-path attestation ledger could pass `git record-commit --dry-run` but fail the real commit hook as a cross-task mutation owned by TASK-GIT-0024.
expectedBehavior: Protected-push recovery preserves the exact authority-provided `git attest` command whenever the remaining blocker is historical attestation, without inventing task, commit, or lane values. The help surface lists `attest`. A generated attestation ledger has the same governed commit outcome in dry-run and write modes.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0244 push after emergency commit 34f50a551, `node atm.mjs git push --actor codex-git-series-captain --branch main --remote origin --json` failed with ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED. `node atm.mjs git recover-push-fail ... --json` returned ATM_GIT_POST_PUSH_FAIL_ALLOW/retry-after-no-op instead of attestation guidance. `node atm.mjs git attest ...` succeeded and wrote `.atm/history/evidence/TASK-GIT-0024.historical-work-admission-attestations.json`, but `node atm.mjs git record-commit --actor codex-git-series-captain --message ... --json` failed with ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED after its dry-run accepted the same single staged file.
followUp: Revalidated on 2026-09-03: `git --help` lists `attest`; tests/cli/git-record-commit.test.ts proves a forward historical-attestation ledger passes both record-commit dry-run and the actual pre-commit hook with no staged residue; and tests/cli/git-admission-cli.test.ts proves recover-push-fail preserves the authority-provided `git attest` command for ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED rather than emitting generic rebase/split guidance. Frozen-runner publication remains a separate release concern.
